_note: The 'what's new since you left' bullets. Read by scripts/send-winback.mts and scripts/send-return-intent.mts; rendered by core/mailer.ts and by the returning-member wall at app/unauthorized. Edit freely to keep the copy evergreen — no code change or redeploy is needed, the next send picks it up. 'title' is bolded, 'body' follows an em-dash. If this file is missing or invalid, the senders fall back to DEFAULT_WINBACK_HIGHLIGHTS in core/mailer.ts.
_since_note: 'since' is the ISO date the item shipped, and it is what makes these emails cohort-correct: core/winbackHighlights.ts shows a reader only what landed AFTER they left, newest first, so a June leaver and a September leaver get different mail from the same template and no reader is ever told 'a lot has changed' about things they already used. OMIT 'since' for an item whose real ship date you can't verify — undated items are evergreen (shown to everyone, never counted as new), which is the honest default. Do NOT guess a date: an item dated too early silently disappears from the cohort it would most impress. Dates below were read off git history; anything predating this repo's first commit (2026-08-20) is deliberately left undated.

highlights.title: Rebuilt for phones and tablets
highlights.body: a new phone layout from the top bar down, with a live quote that doubles as the symbol picker and charts redrawn for a small screen: drag to pan, pinch to zoom, press-and-hold for a crosshair.

highlights.title: Forecasts that keep score
highlights.body: the Intraday Cone redraws a price band every 15 minutes and scores its own odds against a simple baseline, and the Track Record publishes every Daily Forecast ever graded, misses named and dated. Both free.

highlights.title: Gamma Terminal
highlights.body: the Gamma Chart and the Gamma Terminal folded into one flagship page: price with the levels drawn on it, and beside it either two strike-aligned gamma ladders or net dealer gamma by price. Live for members, and free on a ~15-minute delay, ladders included.

highlights.title: 0DTE on the Daily Replay
highlights.body: switch any replayed session to the expiry that settled that afternoon, and the walls, flip and max pain are rebuilt from that book alone, so you see what actually had to be hedged into the bell.

highlights.title: Spread Monitor
highlights.body: how wide the option market is quoted, which side is expensive, where the chain thins out and how much has no bid at all, ranked against the same symbol at the same time of day.

highlights.title: Your levels on your own charts
highlights.body: four integrations across TradingView, thinkorswim, NinjaTrader 8 and Sierra Chart. The first two are free manual-entry scripts; the Pro studies poll the API and keep the Gamma Flip, Call Wall, Put Wall, Max Pain and Pin Strike current on their own.

highlights.title: The Daily Gamma Forecast
highlights.body: every morning we commit in public to a projected range, an expected-volatility call and gamma levels with touch odds - never a direction call - then grade it at 4 PM and publish the receipt. The running hit rate is on every forecast page with its confidence interval, whether it flatters us or not.

highlights.title: Gamma Shift
highlights.body: what changed, not just where things stand: the per-strike move in modeled dealer gamma between two points in time, with expiry roll-off separated out so it doesn't read as fresh positioning.

highlights.title: ES and NQ
highlights.body: futures are first-class now, with their own gamma levels, their own free pages, and the same read as SPY, SPX, QQQ and NDX everywhere else, projected onto the futures price at fair value.

highlights.title: Three new metrics
highlights.body: Market Tide folds gamma and flow across the covered indices into one bearish-to-bullish score, Pair Comparison puts any two indices side by side on strike-aligned Net GEX ladders with a replay scrubber, and Volatility charts put/call IV skew against realized-versus-implied.
